## Problem

Who is blocked, and by what? Separate observations from assumptions.

## Smallest useful change

What changes? What stays out of scope?

## Acceptance criteria

How could someone else verify that this helped?

## Evidence and risks

Public references, compatibility concerns, and uncertainty. Do not invent demand or beneficiaries.
